Snakk norsk – få teksten der markøren st: Speak Norwegian and get text at your cursor. Speech recognition runs on this Mac. No account, key or subscription is needed.
Velg hvordan du vil skrive: Choose how you want to write
Begge NB-Whisper Large-modellene følger: Both NB-Whisper Large models are included.
Velg «Tillat» når Mac-en spør. Mikrofon,: Choose Allow when your Mac asks. You can select a microphone, including BlackHole 2ch, later in Settings.
Åpne Systeminnstillinger → Personvern og: Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility (Device Control and Data Access on newer macOS). Add DSSA Tale from Applications and allow access. This lets the app paste into your active text field.
Allerede slått på? Fjern den gamle DSSA: Already enabled? Remove the old DSSA Tale entry, add the app from Applications again, then restart it.

Appen og modellmotorenes CPU-bruk, målt: CPU use of the app and its model engines, as a share of the Mac's total processor capacity.
Samlet arbeidsminne for appen og dens mo: Combined resident memory of the app and its model engines (RSS). Shared memory may be counted more than once.
GPU-tallet gjelder hele Mac-en. Separat: GPU usage is for the entire Mac. Separate app GPU usage is unavailable.
